items.title: 6.2.2 Rule for Writing the Equation of a Tangent to a Circle (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Book p. 175: 6.2.2 substitution rule (i)-(v) for the tangent at (x1, y1); Note box: rule holds for all conics

blocks.text: Pichle sabaq mein tangent ka formula hum ne lambi derivation se nikala. Har sawal mein woh derivation dohrana waqt ka ziyaa (barbaadi) hai. Is liye kitab ek chhota sa rule deti hai jis se circle ki equation dekh kar seedha tangent likh sakte hain. Is sabaq mein yahi rule seekhenge, aur yeh bhi dekhenge ke yeh kaam kyun karta hai, taa ke ratta na lagana pare.

Hum upar saabit kar chuke hain ke circle
\[x^{2} + y^{2} + 2gx + 2fy + c = 0\]
ke point \((x_{1}, y_{1})\) par tangent ki equation yeh hai:
\[xx_{1} + yy_{1} + g(x + x_{1}) + f(y + y_{1}) + c = 0\]
Yeh equation circle ki equation mein neeche wali tabdeeliyan (substitutions) kar ke seedhi mil jati hai:

In paanch tabdeeliyon ko aasan zabaan mein yun parhiye: square wale terms mein ek variable ki jagah point ki coordinate aa jati hai; akele \(x\) aur akele \(y\) ki jagah variable aur point ki coordinate ka aadha jor aa jata hai; aur constant term ko bilkul nahin chherna. Bas itni si baat hai, magar exam mein yahi rule sab se zyada waqt bachata hai.

blocks.title: Note
blocks.text: Yeh rule tamam second-degree curves (conics) par bhi laagu hota hai.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Rule kaam kyun karta hai? Aaiye har term par substitution kar ke 6.2.1(b) se milayein:
\(x^{2} \to xx_{1}\) aur \(y^{2} \to yy_{1}\) se \(xx_{1} + yy_{1}\) bana.
\(2gx \to 2g \cdot \frac{x + x_{1}}{2} = g(x + x_{1})\); dekhiye, 2 aur 2 cancel ho gaye.
\(2fy \to 2f \cdot \frac{y + y_{1}}{2} = f(y + y_{1})\).
\(c\) waisa ka waisa.
Sab jor dein to bilkul wahi tangent ban jata hai jo hum ne derive kiya tha. Yani yeh koi nayi baat nahin, sirf formula yaad rakhne ka asaan tareeqa hai.
Yaad rakhne ka tareeqa: har square ko do hisson mein baant do, "ek copy variable ki, ek copy point ki" (\(x \cdot x_{1}\)); aur har akele \(x\) ya \(y\) ko variable aur point ki coordinate ki average (aadha jor) se badal do.

blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text:
Yeh misaal kitab ki nahin. Circle \(x^{2} + y^{2} + 4x - 6y - 12 = 0\) par point \((1, -1)\) par tangent nikaliye.
Pehla qadam, tasdeeq ke point circle par hai: \(1 + 1 + 4 + 6 - 12 = 0\). Haan, hai.
Doosra qadam, rule lagaiye (\(x_{1} = 1\), \(y_{1} = -1\)): \(x^{2}\) ki jagah \(x(1)\), \(y^{2}\) ki jagah \(y(-1)\), \(4x\) ki jagah \(4\cdot\frac{x + 1}{2}\), \(-6y\) ki jagah \(-6\cdot\frac{y - 1}{2}\), aur \(-12\) waisa hi:
\[x(1) + y(-1) + 4\cdot\dfrac{x + 1}{2} - 6\cdot\dfrac{y - 1}{2} - 12 = 0\]
\[x - y + 2x + 2 - 3y + 3 - 12 = 0\]
\[3x - 4y - 7 = 0\]
Tasdeeq: centre \((-2, 3)\) hai; radius ka slope \(\frac{-1 - 3}{1 + 2} = -\frac{4}{3}\) aur tangent ka slope \(\frac{3}{4}\); product \(-1\). Perpendicular, bilkul sahi.

blocks.title: Exam tip
blocks.text:
Agar circle \(Ax^{2} + Ay^{2} + Dx + Ey + F = 0\) ki shakal mein ho aur \(A \ne 1\), to ya pehle \(A\) se taqseem kar lein, ya seedha substitution karein (\(Ax^{2} \to Axx_{1}\) waghera). Dono tareeqon se ek hi line aati hai.
Is unit ke baqi conics (parabola, ellipse, hyperbola) par bhi yahi rule lagta hai. Agar kabhi \(xy\) wala term ho to use \(\frac{xy_{1} + x_{1}y}{2}\) se badalte hain (yeh hamari taraf se izafa hai).

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text: Circle \(x^{2} + y^{2} = r^{2}\) par yeh rule lagaiye. Kya aap ko 6.2.1(a) wala formula \(xx_{1} + yy_{1} = r^{2}\) mila? (Yahan \(x\) aur \(y\) ke akele terms hain hi nahin, is liye sirf (i), (ii) aur (v) lagte hain.)

blocks.title: Yaad rakhne wali baatein
blocks.text:
1. Circle ke point \((x_{1}, y_{1})\) par tangent: circle ki equation mein \(x^{2} \to xx_{1}\), \(y^{2} \to yy_{1}\), \(x \to \frac{x + x_{1}}{2}\), \(y \to \frac{y + y_{1}}{2}\); \(c\) waisa hi.
2. Yeh rule 6.2.1 wala formula hi dobara deta hai, bas jaldi.
3. Rule sirf us point par kaam karta hai jo curve par ho.

blocks.title: Aam ghaltiyan
blocks.text:
1. \(x\) ko \(x + x_{1}\) se badal dena aur 2 se taqseem bhool jana. Is se \(2gx\) ghalat taur par \(2g(x + x_{1})\) ban jata hai.
2. Constant term ko bhi badal dena. \(c\) ko haath nahin lagana.
3. Bahar ke point par rule laga kar samajhna ke tangent mil gaya. Aisi line tangent nahin hoti; woh chord of contact hoti hai (Example 12 dekhiye).
